name: bharat sir
ref_text:
"India's tech industry just grew 6%. Hiring grew 2%. That gap is the whole story. NASSCOM's new report says India's tech sector will cross $315 billion this year."
"That's up 6.1%. But headcount? Only up 2.3%. Same revenue growth used to mean way more hiring. Now things are starting to look very different."
"AI is doing more of the work per person. Companies are growing without growing their teams as fast. That doesn't mean no jobs. It means different jobs."
"Over 2 million people in Indian tech have already upskilled in AI this year. The freshers getting picked are the ones who can actually explain an AI project. Save this.
